sloka: श्रुत्वा न भेतव्यमिति स्त्रीजनं तं ततो ऽर्जुनः ।उत्ततार जलात्तस्माद्गङ्गातोयादिवाञ्जनः ।। ७.३२.३८ ॥
transliteration: śrutvā na bhetavyamiti strījanaṁ taṁ tato 'rjunaḥ ।uttatāra jalāttasmādgaṅgātoyādivāñjanaḥ ।। 7.32.38 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the news, Arjuna then reassured the womenfolk not to fear, and emerged from the water like the Anjana mountain rising from the waters of the Ganga.
